Vimeo.instruction: Find public individual works from original creators and production companies, not channel homepages.
Vimeo.note: Private or unindexed Vimeo works may be unavailable. Preserve access hashes.

YouTube.instruction: Prefer original brand, director or production-company releases of individual films.
YouTube.note: Search evidence does not establish that the video has been watched.

Instagram.instruction: Find public indexed individual Reels or posts; never substitute a profile for a specific work.
Instagram.note: Public indexing and login restrictions limit coverage; this is not full Instagram search.

Pinterest.instruction: Find individual Pins with clear original attribution. Avoid generic inspiration boards.
Pinterest.note: Pins may be reposts. Original authorship and reproduction permission remain unverified.

Studio portfolios.instruction: Discover original studio and director project pages. Search the wider web rather than a fixed studio list.
Studio portfolios.note: Portfolio categorisation is provisional until the original project page is reviewed.

Production companies.instruction: Discover original production-company project pages with identifiable work and credits.
Production companies.note: Production credits are only included when present in the cited search evidence.

Award archives.instruction: Find official individual award-entry pages. Do not infer an award from a general archive listing.
Award archives.note: Subscriptions and indexing may limit access. Award names, years and categories require source evidence.
